title: The six short /for doors in FlowWeb reply drafts (/for/teacher and five more) land on a live door instead of a 404

source.ref: FlowWeb build audit 2026-11-18, fix approved by Daniel on a decision card ("Yes, fix the five small ones"): FlowWeb's reply helper links hosts to /for/teacher, /for/studio, /for/venue, /for/music, /for/gathering and /for/maker, which the funnel registry never served.

detail: Six temporary redirects in next.config.ts: teacher to coaches-and-healers, studio to studios, venue to venues, music to event-hosts, gathering to clubs-and-groups, maker to local-businesses. None shadows a registry slug and every destination is one, so lib/marketing/funnel-redirects.test.ts holds. Query tags pass through. Temporary so the short slugs stay free for real doors later. The same change sat unopened on a branch since 2026-11-11 under an id that main has since reused.
